pilot_disclosure.disposition: The pilot was run before this freeze and may diagnose the mechanism only; its rows are excluded from the confirmatory terminal.

strongest_parent: unrestricted 512-state exact DP referee from the unchanged R12 runner
lever_contract: run the strongest parent on each cell and charge its CPU/wall/RSS cost
project its returned six frames and common Tag into the support-two sparse witness representation
accept exact completion only when the projected witness independently verifies and has the same cost as the unrestricted lower bound
do not call this standalone support-two acceleration because the parent was required

confirmatory_panel.matching_order: canonical lexicographic perfect-matching order already frozen by R6M
confirmatory_panel.selection_rule: all canonical matchings not exposed by R12; no outcome-based selection

cost_accounting.comparison: hybrid total versus the same strongest parent; hybrid cannot win merely by reusing the parent

decision_rule.improved: all 24 held-out cells return a valid support-two witness at the parent exact cost; this repairs timeout/completion only
decision_rule.retained_negative: any valid cell fails projection/equality, or the hybrid has no standalone resource value; preserve R12 null in either case
decision_rule.cannot_check: a source binding, parent completion, environment or independent witness check fails
